news-claude-free-01:youtube.text:
Claude Slides, Docs and Design left beta on October 8 and are now on every Claude plan, including Free. Ask for a deck and Claude builds the slides in the chat, turns a slide into social posts in four sizes, and writes docs; PowerPoint and PDF exports keep your formatting, and decks go to Google Slides.
Also new: Claude Motion turns a report into an animated MP4 (Team and Enterprise beta), and Claude Dashboards (paid plans, beta).
Footage: Anthropic official videos. Source: claude.com.
